title: Brandon Henry Facebook Research Audit
scope: Brandon Henry's own Facebook posts and comments about the Nolan Wells case
collectionNote: The Facebook activity interface virtualizes and reloads rows. Counts describe the collected review set, not a forensic Facebook export or a guarantee that every historical item was exposed.

findings.conclusion: A reproduced phone record supplied by counsel displays the Sea Tow call at 4:48 PM on July 4, 2026.
findings.confidence: high for the displayed time; original Sea Tow and carrier metadata still needed

findings.conclusion: Nearshore media and the 4:48 PM offshore coordinate establish a position change by 4:48 PM, not necessarily before 4:31 PM.
Official GPS records dock at 5:44 PM, Fort Bayou departure at 5:52 PM, and dock return at 6:06 PM; a later interview appears to reverse that order.
findings.confidence: high for GPS order; medium for the interview conflict

findings.conclusion: The public record preserves a refusal narrative but does not identify every person who personally heard Nolan's alleged words.
findings.confidence: high that the source chain is incomplete

findings.conclusion: A secondhand compilation says Katie heard boarding calls, said goodbye, assumed Nolan would leave with his friends, and did not witness a refusal.
findings.confidence: low because the account is one step removed from Katie

findings.conclusion: An attorney says the group contacted Katie before the 11:07 PM family call and attributes 'We thought he was leaving with y'all' to her.
findings.confidence: low until the native thread is released

findings.conclusion: Displayed records add 11:07 PM, 11:13 PM, 11:15 PM, 11:35 PM, 12:25 AM, 1:00 AM, and 2:57 AM contact anchors.
findings.confidence: medium; timestamps displayed, call contents mostly not recorded

findings.conclusion: The record progresses from missing-person alarm after 11 PM to an alternate-ride working explanation recorded by MDMR at 1:38 AM.
findings.confidence: high for the documented progression; low for the truth of the alternate-ride claim

findings.conclusion: Interview clips support an overnight stay, general mainland staging, a group meeting dock, and Nolan boarding the Triton outbound.
findings.privacyLimit: Precise residential addresses and unrelated household identities are excluded.

excludedCategories: unsupported criminal accusations or cover-up conclusions
exact probability estimates and behavioral interpretations
private addresses and broad relationship graphs
